contract.method: authored native behavior contract with independent JS reference
contract.description: Return the signed heading of vector (dx, dy), measured in radians from the positive x axis. Use the two-argument arctangent with dy first and dx second. For a zero vector with positive-zero components, return zero.
contract.domain: All numeric arguments are finite and between -1000 and 1000 unless a tighter bound is stated. Inputs do not contain negative zero.
contract.mutationPolicy: Do not modify inputs; array outputs must be fresh with independent storage.

documentation: Native semantics reviewed against VeraCompiler.ets and VeraUi.ets. These tasks are not translated upstream symbols.
